lines.text: Thorne lies sprawled in his own blood outside the cabin. A pistol ball took him in the breast. In his dying breath he scratched '7-3-1' into the deck planks.
lines.journalNote: Examined Nakhuda Thorne's body. Shot down by Kedar. Before dying, he scratched the code '7-3-1' into the wood.

lines.text: Count the stars. Count the knives. The knives are winning. Keep off my quarterdeck!
lines.journalNote: Captain Thorne stood shivering at the ship's wheel, peering into the dark water with wild eyes.

lines.text: The compass is spinning backwards! The stone in the hold has turned the world inside out!
lines.journalNote: Thorne screamed that the lodestone is dead and the Kaal Mani in the bilge is pulling us into the maw.
